login.heading: FamilySearch Visualizer
login.description: See your family tree in simple, progressively richer views.
login.privacy: You sign in with Google through FamilySearch. Your FamilySearch session token and your family data stay in this browser tab; nothing is stored or sent anywhere except to FamilySearch.
login.expired: Your FamilySearch session ended. Sign in again: the view you had open is kept.

relay.heading: Connect through a FamilySearch tab
relay.description: Open FamilySearch and sign in there. Then click the bookmarklet below on that tab. The data travels through that tab, so you do not need to copy a token.
relay.waiting: Waiting for the bookmarklet on the FamilySearch tab…

failed.popup: The browser blocked the FamilySearch window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
failed.timeout: The FamilySearch tab did not answer. Make sure you clicked the bookmarklet on that tab.
failed.closed: The FamilySearch tab was closed. Connect again.
failed.unknown: The connection could not be made. Try again.

relay.bookmarkletSummary: How do I install the bookmarklet?
relay.bookmarkletHelp: Drag the link below to your bookmarks bar. On the FamilySearch tab, click it once. If the page reloads, click it again.

manual.heading: Use an existing access token
manual.description: Enter a valid FamilySearch access token to continue.
manual.helpSummary: Where do I find the token?
manual.help: Sign in on FamilySearch, open the browser developer tools (F12), go to the Network tab, click any request to familysearch.org and copy the value that follows Bearer in the Authorization header.
manual.label: Access token

tree.heading: Your family tree
tree.waiting: FamilySearch asked us to wait {{seconds}} s
tree.error: The family tree could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
tree.canvas: Family tree. Drag to move; use the arrow keys to move, plus and minus to zoom, zero to fit.

panel.label: Details of {{name}}
panel.unavailable: The details of this person are not available.

config.heading: Configuration problem
config.body: The app is missing settings or has invalid ones:
config.hint: Copy .env.example to .env, fill in the values and build again.

error.generic: Something went wrong. Please reload the page.
